title: Explicit read_dir loop separates Ok(None) from Err correctly
description: All four read_dir loops now use 'loop { match dir.next_entry().await { Ok(Some) => ..., Ok(None) => break, Err => warn+break } }' instead of 'while let Ok(Some(entry)) = dir.next_entry().await'. The old pattern silently swallowed read errors (treated Err the same as end-of-directory). The new pattern logs read errors before stopping. A future contributor might suggest 'simplifying back' to while-let. That would be a regression: the while-let form conflates clean EOF with I/O error, losing the warning that tells the operator the scan was incomplete.
